item.title: “Ailey” screened at Art Farm at Serenbe on fifth anniversary of the film
item.description: "Ailey", a documentary on the life and work of award-winning choreographer Alvin Ailey, was screened at the Art Farm at Serenbee on February 7, and included early footage of Ailey's career, performances from the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater, and discussions from Ailey and others about the early days of the company. The post “Ailey” screened at Art Farm at Serenbe on fifth anniversary of the film appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Skip the grocery store flowers wrapped in plastic. Valentine’s Day advice is here
item.description: With Valentine's Day approaching, Alyse Dermer, founder of luxury gift concierge service Mr. Considerate, offers advice on how to choose thoughtful gifts that show appreciation and care, rather than just being expensive or practical. The post Skip the grocery store flowers wrapped in plastic. Valentine’s Day advice is here appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: World’s Largest Serial Killer Exhibit Makes U.S. Debut in Atlanta
item.description: "Serial Killer: The Exhibition" is coming to Atlanta on Feb. 7, featuring the world's largest collection of original artifacts from 150 serial killers, with the goal of exploring the killers through a scientific, historical, and educational lens without glorifying the individual or their acts. The post World’s Largest Serial Killer Exhibit Makes U.S. Debut in Atlanta appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Rome’s Kitchen ATL is taking over, rebranding meal prep services
item.description: Chef Rome, founder of Rome's Kitchen ATL, began prepping 35 meals for one of his clients while listening to music, and has been doing so full-time since being laid off from his corporate job three days ago. The post Rome’s Kitchen ATL is taking over, rebranding meal prep services appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Bills introduced to curb predatory HOA practices in Georgia
item.description: Members of the Georgia Legislature held a press conference to support three Senate bills that would provide protections to home and condo owners who pay HOA, COA, and POA fees, in order to help them keep their properties. The post Bills introduced to curb predatory HOA practices in Georgia appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Obamacare Sign-Ups Drop, but the Extent Won’t Be Clear for Months
item.description: Despite the dramatic cut in premium subsidies, more Americans than expected enrolled in Affordable Care Act health insurance plans this year, although it remains to be seen whether they will keep the coverage as their costs mount. The post Obamacare Sign-Ups Drop, but the Extent Won’t Be Clear for Months appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Brain game may reduce risk of Alzheimer’s and other dementias
item.description: A new study has found that a type of brain training, specifically a computerized game that tests the ability to recognize two separate images in faster and faster sequences, can delay dementia by up to 25% in people over 65. The post Brain game may reduce risk of Alzheimer’s and other dementias appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: FDA refuses to review Moderna’s application for mRNA flu vaccine, company says
item.description: The FDA refused to review Moderna's first mRNA seasonal flu vaccine application, citing an inadequate and poorly controlled trial, despite previous feedback suggesting it was acceptable. The post FDA refuses to review Moderna’s application for mRNA flu vaccine, company says appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Spirit of ’96 kit revealed: Atlanta United pays tribute to 1996 Olympics
item.description: The Atlanta United Spirit of '96 kit was revealed on Tuesday night at the Delta Flight Museum, paying homage to the 1996 Summer Olympic Games with a white primary color and green and gold accents, modeled by former Atlanta United goalkeeper Brad Guzan, Olympic gold medal hurdler Edwin Moses, and Olympic gold medal gymnast Shannon Miller. The post Spirit of ’96 kit revealed: Atlanta United pays tribute to 1996 Olympics appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Atlanta Jazz Festival is turning 49, announces 2026 lineup
item.description: The Atlanta Jazz Festival has announced its lineup for its 49th annual event, featuring Atlanta-based artists, Grammy-winning musicians, and internationally recognized performers, and will be held in Piedmont Park over Memorial Day weekend. The post Atlanta Jazz Festival is turning 49, announces 2026 lineup appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
